payload.note: Expected-Hessian checkpoint expansion: the complete order-g^4 signed gate now has an exact expected-Hessian representation. For any polynomial F of the conditioned free Gaussian, Pi2(F)=(1/2):eta^T E0[D^2F] eta: and its norm is (1/2)Tr(C K_F C K_F). Applied to the combined E, this preserves all W1, W2, and normalization terms in one kernel. Writing C=C0-R_h splits the cross trace into a momentum-diagonal transfer-p bulk and finite-rank corrections; a single rank insertion can also sample transfer 3p, while the double-rank term vanishes for L>=4. The explicit lattice Fourier kernel, its weighted norm bound, whole-lattice g^4 decision, nonperturbative score, and interacting H^-1 estimate remain open.
